name: 17220-multiturn-gptoss20b-1gpu
model: openai/gpt-oss-20b. Ungated, ~13.8 GB of safetensors, already in the local HF cache.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=10, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 300 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. A stream holds one conversation and carries it through all ten of its turns, so 300 requests is thirty conversations.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, ten turns per conversation, ~300 new prompt tokens and 3000 generated per turn, fixed lengths and no spread. The client replays the whole (user, assistant) history every turn, so the prompt the server sees grows 300 -> ~30 k over a conversation and averages ~15 k. Temperature 0, seed 42.
purpose: A ten-turn chat assistant on one GPU, serving ten concurrent conversations whose replayed histories reach thirty thousand tokens.
launch:
model-path: openai/gpt-oss-20b
tp-size: 1

swa-full-tokens-ratio: 0.2

# If the server will not start, this is the ONE lever -- downward, in steps.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

page-size: 64

# Pinned rather than left to the engine's own selection: on SM100 it would resolve
# `trtllm_mha` instead. This is an H100 item.
attention-backend: fa3

# The longest conversation this workload can reach is ~33 k tokens.
context-length: 40960

random-seed: 42
